releaseNotes: Find removes the Internal Storage Usage card; ZIP and APK now show counts only. File Options no longer includes Open because tapping the file opens it. Long-press enables multi-select with batch Share and Add to Category. File-name Voice Search is available from the microphone. Settings > About shows the live installed version directly without a popup. PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint use refreshed 3D-style badges, and the Smart Life launcher icon is redesigned.
